links.outcome: GPT-4 accuracy on UKMLA questions across two time points after vendor-side updates
links.effect: Accuracy changed after vendor updates, improving from 88.0 to 93.7% with MCQ and 68.1 to 81.7% without MCQ; the changes were not all statistically significant, and drivers are opaque.
links.quote: GPT-4's performance improved across all question categories from round one to round two, most notably in management questions without MCQ options (+23.30%), though these differences were not statistically significant.

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4 on UKMLA exam questions across two time points (June 2023 vs December 2024) to assess temporal stability/drift, but does not test an organizational deployment guardrail or practice.
